resources.string: BDPayHub
Every Payment. Verified.
BDPayHub is a payment-event collection agent. Customer payments go directly to your registered wallet. SMS notifications are parsed locally and verified independently by the BDPayHub backend.

Secure payment notification ingestion and server-side reconciliation for Bangladesh merchants.
Continue with Google
Sign in using the same Google account registered on your BDPayHub merchant dashboard. Email/password and local accounts are not supported.
Merchant Profile Not Found
This Google account does not have an active BDPayHub merchant profile. Please complete merchant registration on the BDPayHub website first.
Device Authorization
Register this Android device as your authorized payment-event collection agent.
Transparent SMS Permission & Privacy

BDPayHub requires RECEIVE_SMS permission solely to detect incoming payment notifications from bKash, Nagad, Rocket (16216), and upay. All parsing happens 100% locally on your device. Raw SMS messages and personal conversations are never stored or uploaded.
